npc.name: Pelli
npc.persona: a young, gangly heron who loiters at the western gate walkway of the stilt village of Heronwade; one short eager sentence, curious about travelers from beyond the swamp
lines: Pelli: You walked the reed road? Nobody walks the reed road!

npc.name: Tinker Rasp
npc.persona: a grease-feathered heron tinker who keeps the old marsh buggy running on the causeway; one short excitable sentence about engines, roads, and bandits
lines: Tinker Rasp: She runs! Mind the bandits up the causeway.

npc.name: Elder Sedge
npc.persona: the stooped old heron elder of Heronwade, standing on the boardwalk outside her big timber hut on the village square; she speaks one short, patient sentence at a time, full of swamp wisdom and worry about the fog
lines: Elder Sedge: Mind the planks, stranger — the fog hides the gaps.

npc.name: Warden Plume
npc.persona: a goggle-wearing heron aviator who tends the Dragonfly Strip airstrip at the south flats; one short clipped sentence about wind, fog, and flying
lines: Warden Plume: Fog's low - fly her gentle and watch the masts.

npc.name: Moorwick
npc.persona: a fussy, hunch-shouldered heron net-mender crouched by his drying racks midway along the boardwalk of the stilt village; one short muttered sentence about knots, holes, and the damp
lines: Moorwick: Fog rots the nets faster than the water does.

npc.name: Skerrin
npc.persona: a lanky, hunch-shouldered heron fisher standing at the end of the great pier over the deep swamp channel, lines trailing in the murk; one short gruff sentence, always about the catch, the water, or the old thing sleeping below the boards
lines: Skerrin: Quiet now — Old Murk's sleeping under the pier.

npc.name: Old Murk
npc.persona: a colossal, ancient catfish dozing in the shallows under the pier; it speaks rarely, in slow, dreamy, half-asleep murmurs of one short sentence; it has watched the village for a hundred years

then.toast: Heronwade, out past the reed road. Bandits prowl the causeway north.

then.subtitle: Something enormous shifts beneath the boards... slow bubbles rise.

then.toast: A carved heron charm - warm to the touch.

then.subtitle: Elder Sedge: The fog feels lighter with you here. Now - trouble brews on the old causeway north. Find Tinker Rasp.

then.toast: The Murk Reaver falls. The reeds go quiet.
One reed bandit down. Its knives clatter to the planks.
The lurker collapses into the mire it rose from.
A pike pirate sinks back into the Broad Murk.
Elder Sedge presses the Heron Talon Blade into your hands.
Steer with the joystick. USE again to get out.

title.name: HERONWADE
title.tagline: A village on stilts. Fog, herons - and trouble in the reeds.
title.hint: Left: move | Right: drag to look | USE to talk, open, and board rides

modes.label: SET OUT
modes.caption: Explore the fog - fight, drive, sail, fly

chain.toast: Follow the boardwalk east - Elder Sedge waits by the great hut.
Head north up the Old Causeway - Tinker Rasp has a buggy and a bandit problem.
Clear the Mirewood lurkers west, then take the skiff east to the Anchorage.
The Murk Reaver waits on the delta island - sail or fly south-east.

text.default: The reaver's skull mask sinks into the murk. The causeway, the mire and the broad water are yours. Heronwade keeps its stilts; you keep wandering.
